member.name: DigestLengthTable
member.returns:
The returned byte array contains the computed message digest. Its length is determined by the bit length of the digest algorithm, as shown in the following table.
Digest Bits Array Length (bytes)
256 32
384 48
512 64

member.name: DigestEmptyInputWarning
member.para: Although the cryptography specifications define message digests for the empty array, they are of no practical value in the contexts in which this class is intended to be used, which include comparing and validating strings and files. In such contexts, an empty array or stream is always indicative of an error.
